pokemon_scp.name: Poliwhirl
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0061 is to be contained in a mid‑depth aquatic chamber with spiral‑pattern dampeners. Personnel must avoid prolonged visual contact with SCP-0061’s abdominal pattern.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0061’s abdominal spiral induces mild hypnotic effects, including slowed reaction time and impaired judgment. SCP-0061 can generate water pressure bursts capable of knocking down adult humans.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but easily startled. Uses spiral pattern defensively.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0061-A: A researcher stared at SCP-0061’s spiral for 45 seconds and became unresponsive.
Addendum 0061-B: Water bursts show directional precision.

pokemon_scp.name: Poliwrath
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0062 is to be contained in a reinforced aquatic combat vault with shock‑absorbent walls. Personnel must not enter during agitation cycles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0062 possesses immense physical strength and hydrokinesis. Capable of generating water shockwaves strong enough to fracture reinforced barriers.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and territorial. Shows strategic combat behavior.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0062-A: SCP-0062 shattered a reinforced barrier with a single punch.
Addendum 0062-B: Hydrokinesis appears linked to SCP-0062’s heart rate.

pokemon_scp.name: Abra
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0063 is to be contained in a psychic‑dampened chamber. Personnel must avoid startling SCP-0063 to prevent spontaneous teleportation.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0063 can teleport short distances when threatened. Teleportation leaves behind faint electromagnetic residue.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Sleepy and non‑aggressive. Teleports reflexively when touched.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0063-A: SCP-0063 teleported through a sealed barrier during a containment drill.
Addendum 0063-B: EM residue shows fractal patterns.

pokemon_scp.name: Kadabra
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0064 is to be contained in a reinforced psychic vault with triple‑layer dampeners. Personnel must undergo cognitive shielding training.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0064 exhibits advanced telekinesis and mind‑alteration abilities. Can induce hallucinations or memory distortion in exposed personnel.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but manipulative. Shows awareness of personnel emotional states.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0064-A: SCP-0064 altered a guard’s perception of time for 12 minutes.
Addendum 0064-B: Telekinetic force exceeded 2,000 N during testing.

pokemon_scp.name: Alakazam
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0065 cannot be fully contained. Partial containment relies on maximum‑strength psychic dampeners and negotiation protocols. Personnel must maintain respectful communication.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0065 possesses intelligence surpassing human levels and can manipulate matter through advanced psychic force. Capable of reading and altering memories with precision.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Cold, analytical, and self‑aware. Displays contempt for containment.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0065-A: SCP-0065 disabled all psychic dampeners simultaneously without physical interaction.
Addendum 0065-B: SCP-0065 claims to perceive multiple timelines.

pokemon_scp.name: Machop
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0066 is to be contained in a training‑grade combat chamber. Personnel may interact with SCP-0066 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0066 is a humanoid organism with enhanced muscle density. Capable of lifting objects several times its own weight.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly and eager to train. Shows fascination with repetitive exercise.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0066-A: SCP-0066 lifted a 300 kg weight with minimal effort.
Addendum 0066-B: Muscle fibers show anomalous regeneration.

pokemon_scp.name: Machoke
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0067 is to be contained in a reinforced combat vault. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0067.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0067 exhibits extreme strength and can break reinforced restraints. Musculature emits faint heat during exertion.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Competitive and prideful. Displays dominance behavior.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0067-A: SCP-0067 bent a titanium bar during testing.
Addendum 0067-B: SCP-0067’s strength increases when observed.

pokemon_scp.name: Machamp
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0068 is to be contained in a titan‑grade combat vault with automated restraints. Personnel must not enter without full hazard armor.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0068 possesses four arms capable of delivering simultaneous high‑force strikes. Strength output exceeds industrial machinery.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and strategic. Shows awareness of personnel weaknesses.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0068-A: SCP-0068 shattered a reinforced barrier with a four‑arm strike.
Addendum 0068-B: SCP-0068 appears capable of predicting movement patterns.

pokemon_scp.name: Bellsprout
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0069 is to be contained in a botanical enclosure with nutrient‑rich soil. Personnel may interact with SCP-0069 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0069 is a plant‑based organism capable of rapid vine extension. Mouth secretes mild corrosive fluid.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile but curious. Uses vines to explore surroundings.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0069-A: Corrosive fluid dissolved a plastic container.
Addendum 0069-B: Vine extension reached 3 meters during testing.

pokemon_scp.name: Weepinbell
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0070 is to be contained in a toxin‑filtered botanical chamber. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0070’s mouth.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0070 secretes highly acidic digestive fluid capable of dissolving organic matter within seconds. Vine appendages allow rapid movement.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when hungry. Attempts to engulf nearby objects.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0070-A: Acid secretion dissolved a steel plate.
Addendum 0070-B: SCP-0070 attempted to consume a containment drone.
